payload.title: Platform pages for Auritus and Papyrus
payload.description: The platform page lists eleven components but not Auritus (live at aurit.us, open-source TTS embed) or Papyrus (the newsroom the engage page already sells). Both are ad-campaign products. Add platform/auritus.mdx and platform/papyrus.mdx with real preview images, one-sentence promise, what is live today from each repo README, and an engage or product-site call to action. Facts: Auritus CLI is not on PyPI yet; Papyrus runs the Anth.us newsroom. Needs real images, so not done in the 2026-10 review.
